title: [BUG] Bash tool is completely unresponsive - no commands are executing or returning output
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [X] Anthropic API
  - [ ] AWS Bedrock
  - [ ] Google Vertex AI
  - [ ] Other: <!-- specify -->
- Claude CLI version: `1.0.43`
- Operating System: macos 15.5 (24F74)
- Terminal:  Terminal App

## Bug Description
```
The Bash tool stopped working completely during a session. Multiple commands were attempted but none returned any output or error messages. This includes simple commands like:
  - pwd
  - ls
  - echo "test"
  - npm run typecheck

  Even with explicit timeout values, no response was received. The tool appears to be completely unresponsive.
```

```
> Show me your todo

⏺ Here's my current todo list:

  1. Update CI/CD to support Testcontainers (pending, low priority) - This is the only remaining task from the original test improvement work.

  All other tasks have been completed:
  - ✅ Created @makedir/testing package structure
  - ✅ Set up Testcontainers infrastructure
  - ✅ Created test database setup utilities
  - ✅ Implemented shared test fixtures and factories
  - ✅ Created integration tests for AccountRepo and DirectoryRepo
  - ✅ Configured packages to use Vite
  - ✅ Added transaction testing scenarios
  - ✅ Refactored factories to use drizzle-seed
  - ✅ Created beforeAllSetupDb() helper

  We just finished updating the tests to use drizzle-seed's reset() function and I was trying to remove the DatabaseCleaner files that are no longer needed.
```

I also asked it to make a web search - it seems it didn't work too.

## Steps to Reproduce
TBH I don't know. I had a long session, compacted our dialog mb 5 times already - it was working completely fine. I didn't reach context limit (min amount was something like ~20%, but I often compacted after a subtask is complete)

## Expected Behavior

Well... It should work? :D

## Actual Behavior

It doesn't. :)
